general_information.Description: Main objectives: - Forming research orientation in the project development process: specifically in the culture and commerce environment - Applying the essential skills for the final project - Getting students to apply the knowledge they have learned and researched in the field of advertising communication: brand identity, packaging, information graphics... to come up with products that are practical and highly applicable. - Students must work in a group. The number of members for each group, decided by the Head Academic of campus, could be variable from 2 to 3 students The project is done in 4 stages with feedback and discussion at each stage. Students are expected to discuss, organise, present and critique their work with a high level of professionalism, and implement research strategies that contribute to the overall finished project 1) Progress on Project (04 reports): 45% - Report 1: 15% - Report 2: 10% - Report 3: 10% - Report 4: 10% Mark of each report must be >= 4/10; 2) Final Product and Caspton Document (by instructor): 5%; Final Product and Caspton Document (by instructor) >=4 3) Project Defense - Final product and Capstone Project Document (by council):20%; - Presentation (Oral Project Defense): 30% Project Defense >=5 4) Final results:100%; Final Result >=5/10 Final Product and Caspton Document must be submitted before deadline
general_information.StudentTasks: (1)Choose the project within the selected concentration (2)Divide and schedule work (3)Attend all scheduled meetings with supervisor (4)Produce document and product according to project requirement (5)Defense individually work in front of examination board
general_information.Tools: - Be able to use appropriate tools for selected fields such as: Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere... - Manual skill (handiwork)

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Forming the habit of in-depth research on the history of problem development, cultural attachment (specifically by topic of the project), product life cycle (from ideation-production-consumption-end of use phase) Demonstrate project management competence, divide work in a team according to the project planning timeline.
Demonstrate professional behaviors, morality, social responsibilities and a sense of dedication to community.

Producing a clear research structure with summary: problem, scope of target audience, problem-solving orientation... Analyze and store collected data Use tools to process research data, know how to present research results (conclusion,...)

Be able to use manual skills and appropriate tools for selected fields such as: Illustrator, Indesign, Photoshop, Premiere, After Effects… Demonstrate aesthetic competence through the management of shapes, spaces, colors, materials to match product needs. Meet the needs of target groups of users.

Demonstrate the ability to present the project size: high-aesthetics and highly applicable, clear structure, maintain design style consistency. Implement quality standards according to specialization or should be agreed to by the Design Department (Material tab)
Build style guides, logo, mood board, illustrations, materials… suitable for the final product Creating a neat, well laid-out and carefully formatted thesis, suitable for the design style
Describe the core users clearly (end user, target user...) Specify user requirements, align with research results Divide product functions coherently, describe the product cycle experiences clearly
Understand and implement test methods: survey target audience (directly), test print and post production, ... to support the project completion phase
Understand product manufacturing and packaging processes. Display final product and presentation.

assessments.Category: Final product and Capstone Project Document
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Combination of all relevant acquired knowledge, and research and written skills
assessments.Grading Guide: • Individual mark for this assessment is decided by the group supervisor, and this mark would be the same for all members in group
assessments.Note: Check if the document, product are adapt to the basic requirements of a capstone project Check for plagiarism

assessments.CLO: CLO1, CLO2, CLO3, CLO4, CLO7, CLO8, CLO9
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: • Report No.1: CP Proposal• Report No.2: Design Proposal• Report No.3: Design finalization and evaluation• Report No.4: Báo cáo duyệt thử tốt nghiệp and evaluation
assessments.Grading Guide: • Based on the schedule of the syllabus, each group report will be evaluated by the group supervisor. This evaluation is called progress assessment. • Individual mark for each progress assessment report is decided by the group supervisor and is assessed on the basis of the actual contribution by that individual to the group report. The individual mark can be lower or higher than the group mark and is in the range from 0% to 120% of the group mark where the average score of group members cannot be more than group mark.
assessments.Note: All four progress assessment reports: - Report 1: 15% - Report 2: 10% - Report 3: 10% - Report 4: 10% Mark of each report must be >= 4/10

assessments.Duration: At least 30 minutes for each group
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Combination of all relevant acquired knowledge, and practice and presentation skills
assessments.Grading Guide: • Presentation mark is given by each member of referee committee for each student on final project presentation. This personal mark is the average of all member of referee committee.
assessments.Note: 50% of the whole project including: - Final product and Capstone Project Document: 20%; - Presentation (Oral Project Defense): 30% Every member has to speak at least 10 minutes for the presentation.

schedule.Topic: CP Proposal (1) - Ideas (minium 3 ideas) - Assumptions on each idea - Define problems - Reason & goals - Data analyze & Analyze problems - Overal messages. - target audiences - Art direction: Moodboard & References.
schedule.Student's Tasks: - One month before the graduation semester, students are required to select their specialized topics with the academic department: - Reading Syllabus - Prepare for CP Proposal

schedule.Topic: CP Proposal (2) - Research plan on the choosen idea - Research & conclusions - Reason & goals - Competitors - Target Audiences (Demographic, Geographic, Psychology, Behavioral) - Key messages - Inspiration - Overall moodboard - Art direction - Scope of work - Production timelines
schedule.Student's Tasks: Register for the Project Submit asumptions list submit research plan
- Student report on the progress base on research plan

schedule.Topic: Submit Report No.1 (15% of the whole project) Design Proposal- presentation and submission CP Proposal (1) - Research report: Market research; User analyze; Product research; UX research - Data analyze & Analyze problems - Ideas brainstorming & Assumptions: Define the problems; Target market; Target users; Production introduction: main features, product cycle life & usage. - Art direction: Moodboard & References. - Project timeline Event: Floor plan, Media plan & Estimated budget
schedule.Student's Tasks: Submit Report No.1 Completing project for the first time (need lecturer's approval for layout and structural design to printing) - Give presentation the results from research phase - Research conclusion - Moodboard, layout, structure... - User research, competitor - data, evidence, research methods.
Edit and add Report No.1 as required. - Resubmit Report No.1 if required
Process of redesigning, with combinations of solutions based on comments of report No.02 and practical experiences.

schedule.Topic: Submit Report No.2 (30% of the whole project) Pre-production: users, features, art style, material, texture, design structure, project timeline… Branding: Brand ideals & Designing Identity system, test printing scale 1:1 Web/App Persona, Sitemap, user flow, wire frame, app/web branding, UI tool kit & micro interactive motion, demo screens (minium 5 screens). Infographic: data visualization demo, project branding, test printing scale 1:1 Event: Design, graphic & media, test printing & material

schedule.Student's Tasks: Process of redesigning, with combinations of solutions based on comments of report No.02 and practical experiences. - Resubmit Report No.2 if required

schedule.Topic: Submit Report No.3 (70% of the whole project) The product set includes: final design system, media, illustrations & photography, prototype, print publications. Branding: final Brand guideline, Designing Identity system, Marketing plan & sample marketing campaign, product printing scale 1:1 Web / App: user testing, UI tool kit, prototype, App promotional marketing campaign. Infographic: data visualization, printing scale 1:1, project promotional marketing campaign. Event: production all items, printing scale 1:1

schedule.Student's Tasks: Process of redesigning, with combinations of solutions based on comments of report No.03 and practical experiences.
Prepare for Report No.4 Students must complete the entire project and 70% of the thesis progress
Submit Report No.4 - Prepare for Defense - Practice for Presentation of Capstone Project

schedule.Topic: Submit Report No.4 (100% of the whole project) The product set includes: final design all items, printing scale 1:1.
schedule.Student's Tasks: Whole Project Document '- Complete your product for graduate exhibition. 'Submission all documents (completed 'Submit Reports No.1 - 4) - Students display their capstone project 01 day before the defense date.
